title: hotfix: tighten SLO enforcer backoff to avoid regional thrashing during failover
author: Maya Gupta
description: Context: During a regional outage on 2026-02-17 we observed aggressive SLO enforcer backoff ordering combined with simultaneous regional failover that triggered oscillation between regions (regional thrashing). Motivation: prevent repeated failovers and reduce customer impact by making the SLO enforcer backoff deterministic, adding jitter smoothing and an ordering guard for multi-region decisions. Summary of changes: 1) Introduce ordered backoff window per-customer to ensure incremental backoff only advances when previous backoff fully settles; 2) Add adaptive jitter smoothing that decays over 30s to avoid synchronized retries across replicas; 3) Add a regional-failover lock to prevent concurrent failover actions for the same route; 4) Add extra metrics and tracing hooks for backoff state transitions and failover decision reasons; 5) Small config knob to opt routes into the new algorithm (default on for release). Testing: unit tests for ordering/state transitions, integration test simulating region outage with 2000 concurrent requests, manual canary rollout against staging and a partial rollout in us-west-2. Rollout plan: squash-merge to release branch, automated canary to 10% of traffic for 2 hours, monitor slo.backoff_throttle_rate and routing.failover_count. Rollback: revert config toggle or emergency patch to restore previous behavior. Related: ENG-4216. This description intentionally single-line for ingestion and search consistency.

review_comments: Liam Chen: Can you explain why we need both jitter smoothing and ordered backoff? It seems like duplication of purpose.

Maya Gupta: Ordered backoff prevents state races when multiple controllers attempt backoff advancement. Jitter smoothing reduces synchronized retry spikes across replicas. Both are needed to address different root causes of thrashing.
Sofia Martinez: s/service-level tests/integration tests - please add a case for partial network partition where region comes back slowly.
Maya Gupta: Added integration case that simulates packet loss and slow recovery in d2b0f3c and validated behaviour in staging.
Ravi Patel: Suggest adding a Prometheus alert for routing.failover_count > 3 in 5m during canary.
Maya Gupta: Added alert note to runbook and a temporary canary dashboard tile; will follow up with SRE to finalize thresholds.
release_notes: Hotfix: Improve SLO enforcer backoff to prevent regional failover thrashing. Adds deterministic ordering, jitter smoothing, regional failover lock, and observability. Rollout: canary 10% for 2h then ramp.
notes_for_oncall: If increased routing.failover_count or slo.backoff_throttle_rate spike observed after rollout, flip slo_enforcer.backoff_algorithm: legacy in slo-configmap and open incident. For urgent rollback revert the merge commit or apply emergency config change to disable new algorithm.
